proof_scope.2V01: Defines the loop Lie algebra; verifies Jacobi coefficientwise and evaluation homomorphisms directly.
proof_scope.2V02: Proves the residue cocycle is alternating and satisfies Jacobi using invariance of B; universality of the central extension is cited, not proved.
proof_scope.2V03: Proves the finite geometric sum identity and nonvanishing of quantum integers when q is not a root of unity.
proof_scope.2V04: Defines U_q(sl2) by generators and relations; no PBW theorem asserted.
proof_scope.2V05: Verifies all rank-one relations on V_n and proves irreducibility via distinct K-eigenvalues and nonzero raising/lowering coefficients.
proof_scope.2V06: Defines the untwisted affine Chevalley presentation and its level-zero quotient; centrality follows from the Cartan null-vector condition. No PBW or deformation-flatness proof.
proof_scope.2V07: Defines the coproduct action and checks rank-one cross-term cancellation; existence of the full Hopf structure including Serre compatibility is cited.
proof_scope.2V08: Directly verifies the two-dimensional Chevalley matrices, level zero, irreducibility and parameter distinction. Drinfeld bridge is fixed separately in 2V0B.
proof_scope.2V09: Computes the invariant line, resonance a=b*q^2, the three-dimensional quotient and nonsplitting; reversing the tensor factors has no invariant trivial line.
proof_scope.2V0A: Defines type-1, level-zero finite-dimensional weight modules; no classification outside this restriction.
proof_scope.2V0B: Defines current series and selected relations; Drinfeld-Beck equivalence is cited. Explicit rank-one bridge uses e0=q^-3*k1^-1*x^-_1,1 and f0=q^3*x^+_1,-1*k1; verifies its difference from FH is a Hopf spectral rescaling.
proof_scope.2V0C: States the type-1 finite-dimensional simple-module classification with P_i(0)=1; proof is an external Drinfeld/Chari-Pressley input.
proof_scope.2V0D: Proves simultaneous generalized eigenspace decomposition by reducing the commuting algebra to finitely many generators and iterating primary decomposition.
proof_scope.2V0E: Defines q-character and proves exact-sequence additivity; multiplicativity and injectivity are Frenkel-Reshetikhin inputs, not consequences of primitive Cartan coproducts.
proof_scope.2V0F: Substitutes k=1,b=a*q into FH current formula; explicitly checks x^-_1,1 and x^+_1,-1 through the rescaled bridge to recover e0=a*q^-1*F and f0=q*a^-1*E; computes both l-weights.
proof_scope.2V0G: Multiplies two fundamental q-characters and subtracts the trivial composition factor to obtain the three-dimensional q-character and T-system.
proof_scope.2V0H: Defines finite-length monoidal K0; shows tensor multiplication descends under biexactness; simple-class freeness uses Jordan-Holder.
proof_scope.2V0I: Cites polynomial-generation/freeness theorem for fundamental representations; explains highest-weight triangular mechanism and derives commutativity from q-character injection.
proof_scope.2V0J: States q-string general-position classification and KR character formula; checks length-one/two specializations. General simplicity theorem is cited.
proof_scope.2V0K: States completed universal R and Yang-Baxter identities; distinguishes formal invertibility, rational normalization and generic invertibility; no invertibility claim at every resonance.
proof_scope.2V0L: Defines partial/twisted trace and proves cyclicity for matrices acting only on the finite-dimensional auxiliary factor; does not assert cyclicity for arbitrary operator-valued matrices.
proof_scope.2V0M: Proves commutation using RTT and auxiliary partial-trace cyclicity under explicit twist/R compatibility and generic invertibility assumptions.
proof_scope.2V0N: Proves additivity by block-triangular trace and multiplicativity by coproduct identity; external input is the universal R coproduct identity.
proof_scope.2V0O: Defines Borel O with multiplicative torus weights, finite weight spaces and finite union of downward cones; states rational highest-l-weight classification as HJ theorem.
proof_scope.2V0P: Defines geometric seeds in the skew-symmetric special case, matrix mutation, frozen noninvertible coefficients; checks involution; Laurent phenomenon cited. Quivers have no loops or oriented two-cycles, not necessarily acyclic.
proof_scope.2V0Q: Computes all five A2 mutation variables and return to the initial cluster up to swap.
proof_scope.2V0R: Uses SIAM Definition6.2 cluster-monomial convention for monoidal categorification and derives reality of corresponding simples; does not adopt stronger historical definition silently.
proof_scope.2V0S: Proves rank-one cluster-ring identification by elimination and T-system; proves all same-cluster tensor products simple and classifies all C1 simples using the cited q-string theorem. Closure/polynomial-ring result is cited HL input.
proof_scope.2V0T: Defines positive/negative prefundamental modules; computes rank-one weight character; general parameter independence and positive q-character formula are FH theorem inputs.
proof_scope.2V0U: Defines support-controlled completed weight/l-weight ring; proves coefficientwise finiteness of convolution; completed O q-character injectivity/multiplicativity cited, not confused with finite-length K0 freeness.
proof_scope.2V0V: Derives rank-one Baxter relation by cancelling parameter-independent prefundamental normalized characters and applying q-character injectivity; retains one-dimensional weight twists. General all-type theorem cited.
proof_scope.2V0W: States FH Theorem5.9, Corollary5.10, Theorem5.11 with W tensor product of simple type-1 finite modules, dual auxiliary R+, root degree and formal v-adic coefficients. Defines u^nu and v_i=prod_j u_j^Cji. No arbitrary complex-specialization convergence or simultaneous diagonalizability/completeness claimed; §§6-7 proof external.
proof_scope.2V0X: Derives Bethe-type equations by pole cancellation assuming simple nonzero Q roots, no q-shift collisions, nonvanishing A,D at the root and regularity of T. Does not prove sufficiency or Bethe completeness.
proof_scope.2V0Y: Cites quantum Grothendieck ring/canonical basis construction and simply-laced specialization/positivity; separates reachable non-simply-laced character results from general conjecture.
proof_scope.2V0Z: Defines twisted lattice algebra and proves associativity from the bilinear cocycle; computes commutation and t=1 specialization.
proof_scope.2V10: Reconstructs HJ rationality necessity proof by finite-rank tail series and an explicit polynomial linear recurrence; does not claim existence of all rational highest-weight simples.
proof_scope.2V11: Defines Laurent polynomials via localization and proves the integer-exponent monomials are a basis by clearing a common denominator.
proof_scope.2V12: Gives full shifted Drinfeld presentation for finite type with mu+=0; proves central products and ordinary level-zero quotient; states O_mu classification Theorem4.12 with both leading-weight decompositions. Checks positive rank-one shifted one-dimensional module; no general classification existence proof reproduced.
proof_scope.2V13: Constructs exact rank-one adjoint truncation with N,a nonnegative and fixed Z,z'; proves coefficientwise A-series existence/uniqueness, leading degree and equality of two rational current expansions. Finiteness Theorem11.15 cited with all truncation parameters fixed; general parameterization remains SIAM Conjecture11.4.

remaining_branches: Postnikov network parameterizations, plabic/on-shell graph moves and positive Grassmannian cell theory are cited, not reconstructed.

Knutson-Lam-Speyer normality, Cohen-Macaulayness, intersection/cohomology and Stanley-symmetric-function formulas for complex positroid varieties are not developed into proofs. Complex varieties are not assigned the real closed-ball theorem.
Galashin-Karp-Lam closed-ball and regular CW proofs are external. The notes explicitly apply them only to the real totally nonnegative positroid cell closures.

General amplituhedron rank preservation and dimension are external inputs. Positive geometry remains SIAM Conjecture7.3 in general; the general closed-ball assertion is a separate conjecture. No complete face stratification or all-m=4 amplitude/canonical-form identification is proved.
General BCFW/on-shell constructions, supersymmetric variables, physical normalization and positive-helicity amplitude formulas in §§3-6 are narrative context only.

General positive-geometry existence, triangulation independence, polytope dual-volume and special amplituhedron theorems are cited; elementary interval, triangle, square and polar calculations are fully written.
The full ABHY associahedron realization and its canonical-form identification, stable M0n compactification and the generic (n-3)! scattering-solution count remain cited inputs.

The general stringy-integral formula (9.2) is not imported because of displayed domain/index/prefactor issues; only the independently derived positive-real four-point Beta limit is covered. Original general stringy-integral source was not read.

The direct critical-point Hessian sum has an explicit overall sign discrepancy in dimension one against the positive flag normalization. 2X0S proves only the one-dimensional signed comparison and coordinate invariance; general twisted de Rham/intersection comparison awaits uniform convention reconciliation.

Orlik-Solomon top-degree/cohomology theorem and equivalence of covector/chirotope axiom systems are external standard foundations. Formal quotient definitions and elementary rank-two calculations are provided.
Eur-Lam canonical tope existence/uniqueness is stated with recursive orientation data and a proof mechanism, not a reconstructed triangulation proof. Later basis and Aomoto results are not developed.

Lam's general residue-factorization and decomposable vanishing theorem remains an external input. 2X14 proves the flag-splitting argument only with the additional no-complementary-face hypothesis and separately proves at-most-simple poles.

General tropical-variety transforms, dual matroid volumes, discrete Laplace and stringy intersection pairings from §§12-13 are not developed. The Gao-Lam-Xue discrete dual-volume work is announced/in preparation in the report and is not upgraded to an established theorem.
